connectorUiConfig.title: Dynatrace Runtime Vulnerabilities V3
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: This connector uses the [Dynatrace DQL Storage Query API](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language) to ingest detected runtime vulnerabilities into Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics. It queries the Dynatrace Grail platform using DQL to retrieve a current-state snapshot of all active vulnerabilities, including exposure status, exploit availability, vulnerable function usage, and data asset reachability. Requires a Gen3 Dynatrace environment (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com) and a platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read***, ***storage:events:read***, and ***storage:system:read*** scopes.
connectorUiConfig.additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on a parser based on Kusto Function to work as expected which is deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.

sampleQueries.query:
DynatraceSecurityProblems
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where VulnerabilityType == "THIRD_PARTY"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where VulnerabilityType == "CODE_LEVEL"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISRiskLevel == "CRITICAL"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISRiskLevel == "HIGH"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISExposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

DynatraceSecurityProblems
| where DAVISPublicExploit == "AVAILABLE"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SecurityProblemId
| take 10

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Dynatrace Gen3 tenant (ex. xyz.apps.dynatrace.com)
customs.description: You need a valid Dynatrace Gen3 tenant (xxx.apps.dynatrace.com) with [Application Security](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/application-security/) enabled. This connector does not support classic environments (xxx.live.dynatrace.com).

customs.name: Dynatrace Platform Token
customs.description: You need a Dynatrace platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read***, ***storage:events:read***, and ***storage:system:read*** scopes. See [Dynatrace platform tokens](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens) for instructions.

instructionSteps.title: Dynatrace Vulnerabilities Events to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Configure and Enable Dynatrace [Application Security](https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/application-security/). 
 1. Create a platform token with the ***storage:buckets:read***, ***storage:events:read***, and ***storage:system:read*** scopes following [these instructions](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/manage/identity-access-management/access-tokens-and-oauth-clients/platform-tokens). 
 2. Use your Gen3 environment URL in the format ***xyz.apps.dynatrace.com***.
